## Try It Out!
### Auto-close Sharetribe listing when offer is accepted

Automatically close a listing when a negotiation offer is accepted and paid. Ideal for reverse marketplaces where customers post projects and providers submit offers — once an offer is accepted, the listing should close to prevent additional offers.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `transaction/transitioned` events with the full resource.
* An IF node checks two conditions: the process is `default-negotiation` AND the transition is `transition/confirm-payment`.
* The Close Listing action marks the listing as closed and undiscoverable.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Update the process name in the IF node if your negotiation process has a custom name.
3. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* A negotiation-type listing configured in your marketplace

### How to customize
* Change the process name filter for different transaction types.
* Add a Gmail notification to inform the listing author that their listing was closed.
* Add a delay before closing to allow for cancellation.
* Only close listings of specific categories by adding a listing type check.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for transitions
Polls for `transaction/transitioned` events with the full resource to access process name and listing ID.

## 2. Check process & transition
Filters for negotiation transactions where payment is confirmed. Both conditions must be true.

## 3. Close the listing
Closes the listing associated with the transaction. The listing becomes undiscoverable in search.
